title: Assam Buranji Or A History Of Assam
author: Harakanta Barua Sadaramin
description: Critical DHAS edition of the official chronicle kept by Sadaramin Harakanta Barua, covering the complete genealogical, political, and cultural history of the Tai Ahom kings in Upper Assam.

sentences.text_roman: chau phaa tai khaw tii mroeng tsaw

sentences.free_translation_en: The heavenly sovereign of the Tai entered the historic capital of the realm.
sentences.free_translation_as: টাই স্বৰ্গদেউ ৰাজ্যৰ ঐতিহাসিক ৰাজধানীত প্ৰৱেশ কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Harakanta Barua Sadaramin (Chronicler)
sentences.notes: Official Buranji entry recording royal arrival.
